* feat(agents): durable intake via workflow + Postgres world

Add phase-1 durable agent orchestration behind `durable_agent_workflows_enabled`
flag. When enabled, read-only agent runs with no prerequisite command go through
a two-step workflow (`composePromptStep` → `startAgentStep`) recorded in Postgres,
giving restart-safe intake with per-step retry. All post-spawn behavior (lifecycle
hooks, SSE, completion detection) is unchanged.

- Install `workflow@4.2.4`, `@workflow/world-postgres@4.1.1`, `@workflow/next@4.0.5`
- Create `lib/agents/intake-workflow.ts` with `"use workflow"` / `"use step"` steps
- Wire `withWorkflow()` into `next.config.ts` for build-time SWC transform
- Start Postgres world worker in `instrumentation-node.ts` when flag is on
- Branch in agent run route: workflow path returns `{via: "workflow"}` in response
- Add `durable_agent_workflows_enabled` to settings, allowed PATCH keys, and tests
- Resolve merge conflict in durable-agent-orchestration plan doc
- Add `busy_timeout = 5000` pragma to SQLite connection

Workflow DB: `tamtam_workflow` on localhost:5432, migrated via `workflow-postgres-setup`.
Env: set WORKFLOW_TARGET_WORLD and WORKFLOW_POSTGRES_URL in .env.local.
